name: list_markdown_files
title: List Markdown Files
description: Recursively list Markdown files (.md, .markdown, .mdx) under the project root, returning relative POSIX paths, byte sizes, and modification times.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

includeDocs.description: Also include Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and PDF documents alongside Markdown files.

name: read_markdown_file
title: Read Markdown File
description: Read a UTF-8 Markdown file inside the project root by its relative POSIX path. Files larger than 512 KiB are safely truncated at a UTF-8 boundary and marked readOnly.

path.description: Relative POSIX path to a Markdown file inside the project root.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: search_markdown_files
title: Search Markdown Files
description: Search Markdown files under the project root with multi-term AND, quoted phrases, exclusions (-word), inline path:/tag:/heading: operators, case sensitivity, whole word, and regex support, returning ranked grouped files and centered highlighted snippets.

query.description: Search query (supports multi-word, quotes, -exclude, path:, tag:, heading:, or regex).

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-200, default 80).

tags.description: Optional list of tags (AND filter) to narrow the search.

regex.description: Interpret query as a regular expression (default false).

pathPrefix.description: Optional relative directory/path prefix to restrict search scope.

includeContext.description: Include previous and next line context around each hit.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: get_backlinks
title: Get Backlinks
description: Find Markdown files in the project that link to the specified Markdown file via [[wikilinks]] or relative Markdown links.

path.description: Relative POSIX path of the target Markdown file.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: save_markdown_file
title: Save Markdown File
description: Atomically write UTF-8 Markdown content to a relative .md/.markdown/.mdx file path inside the project root (max 512 KiB), with optional ETag conflict detection.

path.description: Relative POSIX path to a Markdown file inside the project root.

content.description: UTF-8 Markdown text content to save.

expectedEtag.description: Optional ETag from read_markdown_file for optimistic conflict detection.

force.description: Whether to overwrite even if the file changed on disk.

createDirs.description: Whether to create missing parent directories inside the project root.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: read_markdown_asset
title: Read Markdown Image Asset
description: Read a relative image asset referenced by a Markdown document inside the project root (PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, SVG up to 4 MiB) and return base64-encoded data.

docPath.description: Relative POSIX path of the Markdown document referencing the asset.

assetHref.description: Relative POSIX image path resolved from the document directory.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: list_project_tags
title: List Project Tags
description: Aggregate Frontmatter and inline tags across Markdown files in the project.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: list_project_tasks
title: List Project Tasks
description: List Markdown task checkboxes across the project, optionally filtered by status or path prefix.

pathPrefix.description: Optional relative path prefix to filter tasks.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default 500).

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: toggle_markdown_task
title: Toggle Markdown Task
description: Safely toggle a single task checkbox line in a Markdown file with ETag conflict protection.

path.description: Relative POSIX path to the Markdown file.

line.description: 1-based line number of the task item.

expectedEtag.description: Expected file ETag for conflict detection.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: inspect_project_links
title: Inspect Project Links
description: Scan Markdown files for broken links and ambiguous wikilink targets.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: update_markdown_task_meta
title: Update Markdown Task Metadata
description: Update workflow status, priority, due date, assignee, group, and color metadata on a single Markdown task line with ETag conflict protection.

path.description: Relative POSIX path to the Markdown file.

line.description: 1-based line number of the task item.

expectedEtag.description: Expected file ETag for conflict detection.

status.description: Optional workflow status (updates checkbox state automatically).

due.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD due date or empty string.

assignee.description: Optional assignee handle without @ or empty string.

group.description: Optional custom group name or empty string.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: get_project_graph
title: Get Project Link Graph
description: Build a node-and-edge graph of Markdown files linked by wikilinks and relative Markdown links.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: rename_markdown_file
title: Rename or Move Markdown File
description: Safely rename or move a Markdown file inside the project root and optionally update wikilinks and relative links.

updateLinks.description: Whether to rewrite references across project Markdown files.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: save_markdown_asset
title: Save Markdown Image Asset
description: Save a base64-encoded image into the document's assets/ directory inside the project root.

docPath.description: Relative POSIX path of the Markdown document.

filename.description: Image file name with valid image extension.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: replace_in_markdown_files
title: Replace in Markdown Files
description: Atomically replace matching text across selected Markdown files with optional ETag conflict checking.

pathPrefix.description: Optional relative path prefix filter matching search_markdown_files.

tags.description: Optional tag filter list (AND) matching search_markdown_files.

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression.

expectedEtags.description: Optional map of path to expected ETag.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: read_office_document
title: Read Office or PDF Document
description: Read and parse an Excel (.xlsx/.xlsm/.csv/.tsv), Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), or PDF (.pdf) document inside the project root for offline preview and Markdown conversion.

path.description: Relative POSIX path to an Excel, Word, PowerPoint, or PDF file inside the project root.

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).

name: save_exported_file
title: Save Exported HTML or SVG File
description: Atomically save an exported standalone HTML (.html) or knowledge-graph SVG (.svg) file inside the project root (max 512 KiB).

path.description: Relative POSIX target path ending in .html or .svg inside the project root.

content.description: UTF-8 HTML or SVG content to write (max 512 KiB).

scope.description: Scope of operation: 'project' (current workspace, default) or 'all' (all mounted sibling workspaces).
